item.title: Chicago sets record high temp Monday, 'severe' storms and 40s expected for Tuesday
item.description: <p>Monday’s sunny skies and warm temperatures were record breaking, according to the National Weather Service.</p><p>The official recorded high temperature at O'Hare International Airport was 73 degrees Monday, according to the NWS. The last record high for March 9 was 69 degrees in 2014, said Mark Ratzer, a meteorologist with the weather service.</p><p>The high for March 9 is typically about 44 degrees, Ratzer said.</p><p>But the warm weather is short lived. item.description: <p>Chicago police shot and killed a person in Humboldt Park Monday while trying to pull over a vehicle wanted in a separate shooting investigation, police said.</p><p>Around 5:40 p.m., officers tried to stop a vehicle that was suspected of being involved in a reported shooting that occurred earlier Monday, according to Chicago police.
